name: Premier Village Danang Resort
short_description: A 111-villa, all-pool-villa resort directly on My Khe Beach in Da Nang, with three- and four-bedroom Garden View, Ocean Access and Beachfront villas.
ai_summary: Premier Village Danang Resort, managed by Accor, is an all-villa property of 111 multi-bedroom villas set directly on My Khe Beach, about 10 minutes from Da Nang International Airport. Villas span three categories -- Garden View, Ocean Access and Beachfront -- each with its own private pool, separate kitchen, and living/dining space sized for extended families or groups of up to eight adults. Guest reviews consistently praise the spacious villas, private pools, and quiet beach setting as ideal for multi-generation family trips, with the breakfast buffet and attentive restaurant staff frequently singled out. Some reviews flag inconsistent service standards and note the resort's large villa-and-buggy layout means getting around the property takes longer than a standard hotel.

research_highlights: Multi-bedroom, all-pool-villa format is repeatedly called out as ideal for multi-generation family or group trips
The private beach and quiet setting on My Khe draw consistent praise versus busier central Da Nang hotels
Breakfast quality and variety are highlighted across recent guest reviews
research_watchouts: A minority of reviews describe service lapses or slow response times during peak/family season
Some published room/villa counts vary slightly (106-111) across booking sites; 111 villas is the figure most consistently cited by the resort's own regional listing pages

faqs.question: Does Premier Village Danang Resort have private pools?
faqs.answer: Yes -- every one of its 111 villas has its own private pool, across three categories: Garden View, Ocean Access and Beachfront. Villas range from roughly 300 to over 500 square metres and include a separate kitchen and living/dining space, making them suited to families or groups of up to eight adults.

faqs.question: Is Premier Village Danang Resort on the beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits directly on My Khe Beach in Da Nang's Ngu Hanh Son District, with Beachfront villas offering steps-to-sand access. The resort is about 10 minutes from Da Nang International Airport and a short drive from central Da Nang and the Hoi An corridor.
